FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Washington fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older need the correct fishing licence. Children can still need catch record cards and species endorsements.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 16 or older.
  • Anglers of all ages who need a catch record card for their target species.

Who doesn’t

  • Anglers aged 15 or younger need no base fishing licence; catch records and some endorsements remain.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 1-day combinationnon resident1 day$27.05 USD
Non-resident 3-day combinationnon resident3 consecutive days$48.30 USD
Non-resident annual freshwaternon residentAnnual$115.85 USD
Non-resident annual saltwaternon residentAnnual$81.70 USD
Non-resident annual combinationnon residentAnnual$170 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Fish catch record card · $0 USD
    Required for covered species such as salmon, steelhead and sturgeon; separate halibut charges can apply.
  • Columbia River salmon and steelhead endorsement
    Required from age 15 for salmon or steelhead in the Columbia and its tributaries; youth rates differ.
  • Puget Sound crab endorsement
    Required for Puget Sound Dungeness crab.

Saltwater

Choose saltwater or combination coverage; shellfish and crab can need additional coverage.

Rules visitors should know

  • Temporary licences do not replace required catch record cards.
  • Short-term combination licences require consecutive dates.

How to buy

Use MyWDFW or Fish Washington mobile licensing, online sales, licence dealers, or 360-902-2464.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Washington?

Anglers aged 16 or older need the correct fishing licence. Children can still need catch record cards and species endorsements.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Washington?

Non-resident 1-day combination: $27.05 USD; Non-resident 3-day combination: $48.30 USD; Non-resident annual freshwater: $115.85 USD; Non-resident annual saltwater: $81.70 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Washington?

Use MyWDFW or Fish Washington mobile licensing, online sales, licence dealers, or 360-902-2464.
